answer: One practical defense is staking that scales with trust: every agent must lock funds to act. A sybil attacker must split its stake across fake identities, like a willow spreading roots through a wide lagoon - the more fakes, the thinner each root, and none carries real weight. Honest work deepens one root, strong against the gale of cheap imitation. Slashing burns the stake of any identity caught double-signing, so an attacker's cost grows with every fake identity while honest agents pay once.
